source.publisher: Agenzia delle Dogane e dei Monopoli
source.title: The procedure

observedFacts.eligibilityResidence: individuals residing or domiciled outside the EU
observedFacts.invoiceThreshold: each invoice exceeds EUR 70, VAT included
observedFacts.personalUse: goods intended for personal or family use and carried in personal luggage
observedFacts.exportDeadline: goods leave EU territory within three months following invoice issue
observedFacts.customsValidation: OTELLO digital customs endorsement; red channel may require physical inspection
observedFacts.refundOperator: refund is made by Italian seller; tax-free companies may provide service and deduct fees

limitations: Market-level policy summary; not a guarantee of retailer participation or refund amount.
